number.ladderHelp: Middle button / Alt+right button: move up and down the list to pick a step, then past its left or right edge to change the value. Release to apply, Esc to cancel. Keyboard: Alt+L, arrow keys, Enter.
open.badGraph:
The graph data is incomplete or malformed, so it was not opened.
{detail}
open.badTarget: This address does not name a valid Grape OP. Open the editor from a Grape OP in TD.
open.buildMismatch: The editor core and TD's bootstrap come from different builds; reload the same build.
open.newerVersion:
This graph was saved by a newer Grape. Update Grape before editing; to keep the newer data safe, nothing is written back.
{detail}
open.notGrapeGraph:
This graph is not in the new format (grape-graph). Old graphs will be handled by an importer; the new editor does not open them.
{detail}
open.nothingSent: No edit or apply request was sent.
open.notNewFormat: This Grape OP is not in the new editor's format.
open.reasonCompiler: the frontend compiler cannot handle this graph
open.resetConfirm: TD's graph will be replaced by the default graph, and the content listed above will be deleted. Continue?
open.targetMismatch: TD answered for a different Grape OP than this editor.
open.title: Cannot open the editor

This entry supports the common TOP nodes (no Uniforms, subgraphs or Frames yet). Nothing was edited or applied; these will come back in later rounds.

picker.cannotOpen: This Grape OP cannot be opened here: {reason}

picker.noTarget: Choose a Grape OP to edit.
picker.wrongTarget: This Grape OP is not in the current project. Choose another one.

save.notConfirmed: TD did not confirm that the project was saved; the applied graph is only in TD's memory.

sources.name: Name

sources.nameTaken: The name {name} is already used by another shared source.
sources.noConstants: No global constants yet. A constant is written into the shader as const and can be used by many nodes.
sources.noGraph: Open a Grape OP to see its shared sources.

sources.tdValuesHint: Values TouchDesigner already provides to the shader. No setup needed; they also work inside subgraphs.
sources.textureInputsHint: Each one is an input of the Grape OP in TD, in this order. When no TOP is connected there, it shows its default image.
sources.timeHint: Uniforms that TouchDesigner drives with an expression. The name is fixed; one of each per graph. Remove the expression in TD to set the value yourself.
sources.title: Shared Sources
sources.valueChanged: Shared source value updated; waiting to apply
status.recoveryHelp: On the computer running TD, check that TD is still open (restore its window if minimized), global cooking is on, and TD is not busy with a long task; on a remote device, check the network. After TD restarts, open the editor again from the Grape OP.
status.unsent: Changes not yet sent to TD

switch.explanation: Some changes are not in TD yet. Apply them to TD, or keep a draft in this browser tab before switching (it can be restored when you come back).
switch.title: Switch Grape OP
sync.applied: Applied to TD; the project still needs saving
sync.conflict: The graph in TD seems to have been changed. Choose which version to use.
sync.draftMatchesTd: The draft matches TD's graph; in sync.
sync.glslFailedInTd:
GLSL failed to compile in TD. The graph is saved; TD keeps running the last good Shader.
{log}
sync.hostChanged: This page and TD-Grape in TD come from different builds (TD-Grape was probably updated). Reload this page; unsent changes are kept as a draft.
sync.offlineBusy: TD is not responding (it may be minimized). Your changes stay in the browser and are sent when TD is back.
sync.offlineUnreachable: Cannot reach TD (it may be stuck or closed, or the network is down). Your changes stay in the browser and are sent once connected.
sync.overwriting: Overwriting TD with the editor's draft…
sync.replyMismatch: TD's reply does not match what was sent.
sync.savedCodegenFailed: Graph saved to TD; code generation failed, so TD still runs the last good Shader
sync.savedKnownFailure: Graph saved to TD; this program failed to compile in TD before, so TD still runs the last good Shader.
sync.sendingGraphOnly: Code generation failed; saving only the graph to TD. TD keeps running the last good Shader…
sync.transportFailed: The connection broke or the reply was incomplete; your local document is kept. {reason}
sync.uncertain: Delivery result unknown; automatic sending stopped while checking the version with TD. {reason}
tdValue.glFragCoord: The current fragment position in window coordinates.
tdValue.glFrontFacing: Whether this fragment belongs to a front-facing primitive.
tdValue.glHelperInvocation: Whether this is a helper invocation used for derivatives.
tdValue.glSampleID: Index of the current multisample sample.
tdValue.glSamplePosition: The current sample position within its pixel.
tdValue.glVertexIndex: Index of the current vertex. This is an identity, not an attribute lookup for another vertex.
tdValue.sTD2DArrayInputs: Array of connected sampler2DArray resources, grouped by texture dimension. Select an array item before sampling.
tdValue.sTD2DInputs: Array of connected sampler2D resources, grouped by texture dimension. Select an array item before sampling.
tdValue.sTD3DInputs: Array of connected sampler3D resources, grouped by texture dimension. Select an array item before sampling.
tdValue.sTDCubeInputs: Array of connected samplerCube resources, grouped by texture dimension. Select an array item before sampling.
tdValue.sTDNoiseMap: TD-provided noise lookup texture; connect it to a compatible texture sampling input.
tdValue.sTDSineLookup: TD-provided one-dimensional sine lookup texture. TDSineLookup provides a direct lookup function.
tdValue.tdBoneMat: Bone transform matrix for the selected bone index.
tdValue.tdCameraIndex: Camera index within the current render pass. Pass it flat to Pixel when indexing camera-specific data there.
tdValue.tdColor: Geometry color used by native Phong/PBR before current-instance color is applied. This is the native TDColor accessor, distinct from TDPointColor.
tdValue.tdInstanceCustomAttrib0: Custom instance attribute slot 0 as four components.
tdValue.tdInstanceCustomAttrib1: Custom instance attribute slot 1 as four components.
tdValue.tdInstanceCustomAttrib2: Custom instance attribute slot 2 as four components.
tdValue.tdInstanceCustomAttrib3: Custom instance attribute slot 3 as four components.
tdValue.tdInstanceID: Instance index supplied by TD for the geometry being rendered.
tdValue.tdInstanceIndex: Current instance index used by native MAT. Pass through a flat Vertex Output to use indexed TDInstanceColor in Pixel Stage.
tdValue.tdInstanceMat: Four-by-four transform matrix for the selected geometry instance.
tdValue.tdInstanceMat3: Three-by-three transform matrix for the selected geometry instance.
tdValue.tdInstanceTextureIndex: Texture index associated with the selected geometry instance.
tdValue.tdNormal: Normal of the current vertex before TD geometry deformation. Use TDDeformNorm for a deformed world-space normal.
tdValue.tdNum2dArrayInputs: Compile-time number of 2d array inputs in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNum2dInputs: Compile-time number of 2d inputs in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNum3dInputs: Compile-time number of 3d inputs in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNumCameras: Compile-time number of cameras in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNumColorBuffers: Compile-time number of color buffers in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNumCubeInputs: Compile-time number of cube inputs in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNumEnvLights: Compile-time number of environment lights in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdNumLights: Compile-time number of regular lights in this shader configuration.
tdValue.tdPointColor: Color attribute of the current point, including alpha.
tdValue.tdPointCoord: Coordinates within the point being rendered.
tdValue.tdPos: Position of this vertex in SOP space.
tdValue.tdScreenSpaceCoord: Screen-space texture coordinates used by native MAT screen-space map sampling. Returns the st components.
tdValue.tdTexCoord: Texture coordinates from the selected UV layer.
tdValue.tdTrueCameraIndex: Camera index in the full camera list, as distinguished from the current pass index.
tdValue.tduvUnwrapCoord: Coordinates used for the current UV-unwrapping render configuration.
tdValue.uTD2DArrayInfos: Metadata for each input texture of this dimension. res.xy is reciprocal size and res.zw is size.
tdValue.uTD2DInfos: Metadata for each input texture of this dimension. res.xy is reciprocal size and res.zw is size.
tdValue.uTD3DInfos: Metadata for each input texture of this dimension. res.xy is reciprocal size and res.zw is size.
tdValue.uTDCamInfos: Per-camera information supplied by the render pass, including camera projection data.
tdValue.uTDCubeInfos: Metadata for each input texture of this dimension. res.xy is reciprocal size and res.zw is size.
tdValue.uTDCurrentDepth: Current output depth index when producing a layered or 3D TOP texture.
tdValue.uTDEnvLightBuffersShCoeffs: Nine RGB spherical-harmonic coefficients for the selected environment light.
tdValue.uTDEnvLights: Environment-light settings for the current render pass.
tdValue.uTDGeneral: General render state, including combined ambient-light color and viewport information.
tdValue.uTDGeneralAmbientColor: Combined ambient-light color from the ambient lights used by this render pass.
tdValue.uTDLights: Per-light data for regular lights in the current render pass. Environment lights have a separate array.
tdValue.uTDMats: Camera-indexed transforms between geometry, world, camera and projection spaces. Select a camera entry, then its matrix field.
tdValue.uTDOutputInfo: Output texture metadata. res.xy contains reciprocal dimensions; res.zw contains width and height.
tdValue.uTDOutputInfoResZw: Output width and height in pixels.
tdValue.uTDPass: Zero-based GLSL TOP pass index for multipass rendering.
tdValue.viewportResolution: Width and height of the current viewport.
tdValue.vUV: The original three-component TOP texture coordinates.
tdValue.vUVSt: Texture coordinates of this pixel, from 0 to 1 (the first two components of vUV).
toolbar.label: Editing toolbar
uniform.exportRemains: {uniform} was deleted, but {parameter} of the GLSL OP is still driven by an Export from {origin}; TD-Grape cannot remove that from here.
uniform.rowAdopted: {uniform} uses the row already on the GLSL OP; its values and what drives them are kept.
uniform.rowRecreated: The GLSL OP row of {uniform} was missing (changed or deleted in TD); TD-Grape added it again.
uniformPreset.absFrame: Frames since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.
uniformPreset.absTime: Seconds since TouchDesigner started; keeps running.
uniformPreset.deltaTime: Seconds from the previous frame to this one (all of TouchDesigner).
uniformPreset.frame: Frame on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline.
uniformPreset.frameStep: Frames from the previous frame to this one; more than 1 when TouchDesigner drops frames.
uniformPreset.time: Seconds on this Grape OP's timeline; stops and loops with the timeline. For time that keeps running, use uAbsTime.
